newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - May 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - May 14.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The labour and social affairs minister urged the private sector to find more job opportunities for Saudis.
- Saudi Prince al-Waleed bought three percent of Britain's Cordiant.
- The Czech foreign minister will arrive in Saudi Arabia on Friday on a three-day official visit.
- Mecca's governor inaugurated the Musalli Factory for Jewelery, built at a cost of 65 million riyals.
- Municipality ministry allocated 155 million riyals to set up projects in Saudi Arabia's northern province.
- A second Saudi plane with more than 78 tonnes of foodstuffs, blankets and tents on board left for Iran to help earthquake victims.
